title: Grateful Dead Live at UI Field House, University Of Iowa on 1973-02-24
venue: UI Field House, University Of Iowa
source: partial source: aud cassette master; taped by Mark Owen; sears & robuck deck, floor, 100’ from stage; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96> adobe audition cc > fission > xACT flac 16/44.1; transferred by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Stellar Feb‑73 performance with a spookily great Truckin and confident Wave That Flag, but hindered by uneven audience/soundboard recording.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the off‑the‑charts playing – especially the haunting Truckin jam and a surprisingly tight rendition of Wave That Flag – while lamenting the patchy audio that jumps between audience tape and a brief soundboard snippet. The mix is jarring, making the superb musicianship harder to enjoy.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised highly, but recording quality is described as poor; weighted average yields a solid mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mostly audience tape with a short soundboard excerpt; transitions are jarring and overall clarity suffers, leading to an uneven listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance flows into a heavy Phil‑centered February ’73 jam, providing strong context despite the recording’s inconsistencies.

band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted as heavy on bass during the February ’73 jam.
